title: Get Hired by Christmas! The Secret LinkedIn Hack No One Is Using!
description:
Want a job before Christmas? This secret LinkedIn search trick helps you find real recruiters hiring right now, not ghost jobs, not outdated listings, not generic posts.

This quick hack helps you:
 Find fresh job posts from recruiters who are actively hiring
 Reach decision-makers directly (not HR black holes)
 Apply faster and stand out from the crowd
 Beat your competition before the holiday rush

Do this today to make your job search half as painful and twice as effective. Perfect for anyone who wants a job before the holidays.

transcript: You want a job by Christmas and I want to get it to you in half the time. I'm going to be sharing my favorite job search hack to show you exactly how you can get directly to decision makers and see posts from real people. This is going to get you job leads so much quicker. I've gone into my LinkedIn profile and in the search bar I typed customer success manager or client relationship manager and hiring or were hiring. Now, here's the secret hack. Instead of going to jobs, click on posts. Filter by talking to people in my network, looking at posts in the past 24 hours or the past week. These are posts from actual recruiters who are looking to hire in these positions. Once you've applied, you now know directly who to follow up with, which is going to give you a huge leg up on your competition. Do this and you just might have a job before the big guy makes it down your chimney. And for the gift that keeps on giving, don't forget to like and subscribe at christnercareers.com for more awesome job search gems.
